title: Orchard and Kitchen
author: O. M. Underhill
blurb: Ansel Lockridge, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
